With `--skip-input-snapshot-pin` it exits 1 with 'Analyzer report hashes do not match current byte-identical reports'. Both pins hash the whole repository source tree under apps, packages, integrations, and services. The last pin refresh, de25d49a9 of the architecture_ci_input_pin_20261010 track, predates the Storytime commit 08c36df04, which changed an analyzed file under apps/storytime before the A-53 Red commit 0c459e9eb. A-53 cannot refresh the pin alone, because three tracks have work in flight. The doctor.sh follow-up track of the PM decision of 2026-11-12 owns the repair, with a done date of 11-14.
